name: process-design-vibecoding
description: Turn project requests into a maintained specification, acceptance criteria and verified delivery.

interface.longDescription: A reusable software project workflow for Codex and ChatGPT. Start new products with discovery, an interactive prototype and user feedback. At the first release or live-product testing, ask once whether to maintain the prototype or work only in the product; preserve the recorded choice. Maintain canonical specifications, acceptance and verification evidence. Use host-provided Context7 for version-compatible APIs and optional diagrams where useful. Scales down for bounded fixes and preserves existing conventions.
defaultPrompt: Use Process Design Vibecoding to turn my project idea into a specification and acceptance criteria.
Примени Process Design Vibecoding: внеси мои новые требования в основное ТЗ и обнови приёмку и план.
